lemmas.primary_translation: a phrase used to wish someone good luck

definitions.text: brukt for å ønske noen lykke til (fordi en fra gammelt av trodde at ønske om godt fiske ville ødelegge fiskelykken)
definitions.translation: used to wish someone good luck (because people once believed that wishing for good fishing would ruin fishing luck) (lit. “shit fishing”)
